_help: The Hint Director (story/hints.py): when someone speaks during Ada's turn. Each topic has a condition (the script condition language: see docs/WRITING.md) and a ladder of steps, from an in-character observation by the guardian to an explicit offer by the Grimoire. A step is a node of data/story/hints.script; {guardian} becomes slime or knight, and a guardian without that node simply skips the step. A topic speaks once its condition holds and Ada has been idle for idle_s seconds (default speak_after_idle_s); each step is said at most once per fight; at most one line per turn, then cooldown_turns of silence. Topics are tried in order: the first that is due speaks. While quiet_when holds (she is doing well) only loud topics speak. Names a condition can use: turn, idle (seconds), miscasts (in a row), overflows (casts that spilled), hp and mp (Ada's ratios 0-1), heals and ethers (left in her items), heal_used, ether_used, seen.<table> (she has read it), same_query (the same query this many turns in a row), last_damage, integrity (intact | altered | damaged | broken), foe.mode and foe.intent (from the brain's explain()), foe.aegis (rounds its Aegis still stands), items (how many items are in her satchel), guardian.
quiet_when: last_damage > 0 and miscasts == 0 and hp >= 0.5 and same_query < 3

topics.when: hp < 0.35 and heals > 0 and not heal_used
mp < 0.25 and ethers > 0 and not ether_used
